_comment: Plugin settings baseline for the readme-showcase fixture vault, which exists for the
readme-showcase scenario and nothing else. It is writing-basic's baseline with three
differences, each of which is what a README picture needs to show:
`includeNoteContext` is on, so the open chapter rides on the user turn as a note chip.
The model is a curated catalog id, because its name and id are in every picture. The custom
entry under the same id is a fallback, not a duplicate: selectableModels dedupes by id with
the catalog first, so while the catalog carries it the catalog entry is used, and if a sync
ever drops it this entry keeps the fixture bootable instead of opening on 'No model
selected'. The scripted client is installed at the createChatClient seam, so nothing reaches
Anthropic and the key is a placeholder that only satisfies the enablement gate.
The seeded conversation is titled for the history drawer rather than for the driver.
Everything else is writing-basic's reasoning, which its own settings.json records.
